items: SCREEN CLEANER SPRAY and cloth are designed for the high-end devices and works flawlessly for all electronic screens, including: LCD, LED & OLED Flat TVs, Smartphones, iPhone, iPad(pro), Laptop, MacBook, Mac Book Air & Pro, Computers, Touchscreens, Monitors, e-Readers, gaming monitors, projectors, Tablets, Cartouch and other tech device screens, screen protectors and displays. Can be used as tv cleaner spray and cloth, OLED tv cleaning kit, laptop cleaning kit for macbook, iPad cleaner.

ADVANCED FORMULA works gently on the most delicate screens leaving no scratches. It effectively removes dust, stains, fingerprints, and grime from the screen’s surface. It also forms a protective layer that repels dirt and reduces static electricity. Leaves a streak and smudge free like-new shine. Compatible with all the brands: Kindle, Sharp, LG, SONY, Samsung, Apple , Belkin, Rocketfish, Dell, Optix, HP, Android screens, PC curve and flat monitors

WE CARE. Our 100% biodegradable formula is safe for the environment. It is non-toxic and contains NO alcohol, ammonia, or phosphates. Safe to use around family and pets. Solution has anti static and anti glare effect.

FOR EVERYDAY. Great for everyday screen-care use at home, for desks and technology in the office, in tech classrooms and at work. Or take it while you travel. Working with a cell phone, laptop and 2 monitors? No problem, wiper will clean it all!

IN THE CLEANING KIT you will find a cleaner set that comes in a convenient recyclable bottle, 2 different nozzles: push button sprayer for small devices and trigger sprayer for larger screens, and a microfiber cloth to ensure the premium shine of the screen. This set is perfect for polishing any glass surfaces. Use screen cleaner spray and wipe as MacBook cleaner, Tesla car screen cleaner, computer or keyboard and mouse cleaner, anti static monitor mist, anti glare monitor spray.
